cow.instructions: Could this Rust code be improved by using std::borrow::Cow (Clone-on-Write) to avoid unnecessary allocations or clones?

criteria.true: The code allocates or clones data (e.g. to_string, to_owned, clone) on a path where the input is returned unchanged, so it could borrow in the unchanged case and only allocate when it actually modifies the data
criteria.false: Every allocation is needed because the data is always modified or must be owned, or the code allocates nothing that could be borrowed instead
